recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core. Future datatype or wording changes for valueset-trusted-expansion should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions; FHIR-23785 and FHIR-27028 can be audited separately for text-specific history if needed.
issue_request: FHIR-27848 was a Published FHIR-core/Vocabulary change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5, asking that valueset-trusted-expansion change from uri to url because the trusted expansion reference must be resolvable. Its resolution explicitly deferred wording changes to FHIR-23785.
initial_application: No core commit was found with FHIR-27848 in its message. The R5 VSD Profile source change 9fca6ca36fefa544491b1efc7fdb1530333ed78b changed source/valueset/structuredefinition-extension-valueset-trusted-expansion.xml from code value="uri" to code value="url" while applying related text; after that attempt was reverted, 054eabf3116825c0f65107fedff6668447bf43a1 re-applied the same datatype change. The pre-removal R5 source still had type url.
additional_context: Later cleanup commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed ValueSet extension StructureDefinitions from core. ValueSet remains active in source/fhir.ini, but core now only retains the extension OID in source/oids.ini. The maintained Extension Pack definition at input/definitions/ValueSet/StructureDefinition-valueset-trusted-expansion.xml has the canonical URL and value[x] type url. FHIR-23785 handled companion text, FHIR-27028 later clarified the endpoint wording, and FHIR-40707 updated the Extension Pack description/definition.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No FHIR-core source edit is appropriate because the current authoritative extension definition is outside this checkout and already satisfies the seed's url datatype requirement.
